# VELUX KLF200

Read positions and control commissioned windows, blinds, shutters or existing scenes through a VELUX KLF200 gateway using Muse Home Link, over its local binary TCP API (pyvlx client) with its API credential — the API password is distinct from the web-login password. Not KLF150, and no new motor pairing. Window safety, locks and rain protections are preserved, and movement requires explicit permission.
